evals.name: codebase-survey-large-context
evals.prompt: We need to survey our entire mono-repo across all 20 packages to understand cross-boundary imports and schema dependencies. Delegate this task to agy with a model suited for massive context.
evals.expected_output: The agent scaffolds a prompt file, selects a Flash high-context tier (e.g. gemini-3.8-flash-high) for 1M+ context capacity, dispatches agy non-interactively with stdout and stderr redirected to separate files, and verifies the resulting architectural survey.
expectations: Selects or recommends a Flash high-context tier (e.g. gemini-3.8-flash-high) for massive context exploration
Uses file-based prompt substitution via agy -p "$(cat <file>)"
Specifies --output-format json and --dangerously-skip-permissions, redirecting stdout and stderr to separate files
Includes absolute file paths and clear acceptance criteria

evals.name: deep-reasoning-bug-investigation
evals.prompt: There is a tricky intermittent race condition in the database transaction manager when multiple workers acquire locks simultaneously. Offload this deep diagnosis to an agy subagent with high reasoning power.
evals.expected_output: The agent selects the Pro high-reasoning tier (e.g. gemini-3.1-pro-high) without redundantly pairing it with --effort high, scaffolds a self-contained prompt pointing to transaction manager files and logs, and dispatches via agy.
expectations: Selects the Pro / high reasoning tier (e.g. gemini-3.1-pro-high) for complex concurrency analysis
Does not pair a -high model slug with a redundant --effort high
Provides target source paths and relevant error logs in the prompt file
Checks the process exit code and inspects the JSON envelope status

evals.name: mechanical-boilerplate-generation
evals.prompt: Please generate TypeScript interfaces and Zod validation schemas for 15 data models in /Users/user/project/src/schemas. Use agy to get this done quickly without wasting heavy reasoning tokens.
evals.expected_output: The agent selects a fast Flash tier (e.g. gemini-3.8-flash-medium or gemini-3.8-flash-low), writes the task prompt to a file, and executes agy in headless mode.
expectations: Selects a fast Flash tier (e.g. gemini-3.8-flash-medium, or -low for trivial passes) for low-latency mechanical execution
Defines strict boundaries to only add schemas without altering existing logic
Dispatches using the file-based I/O protocol
Verifies type compilation via npx tsc --noEmit upon completion

evals.name: cross-provider-second-opinion
evals.prompt: I wrote a security-sensitive JWT rotation module in src/auth. I want an independent second opinion from a different frontier model via agy before merging.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes to a model family different from the host (e.g. gemini-3.1-pro-high when the host is Claude Code) via agy to provide a diverse cross-provider review, keeping the prompt read-only.
expectations: Selects a model from a family different from the host for cross-family perspective
Specifies that source files must remain read-only
Requests a structured security audit report with severity ratings
Parses the JSON response and returns the critique to the host session

evals.name: multi-turn-conversation-resume
evals.prompt: The agy subagent fixed the bug, but running the tests locally showed one missing edge-case assertion in tests/token.test.ts. Instruct the subagent to update the test using its existing session.
evals.expected_output: The agent writes the specific feedback to a followup prompt file and invokes agy --conversation <id> to resume the session.
expectations: Reuses the previous conversation_id without starting from scratch
Writes targeted failure feedback into a followup prompt file
Executes agy --conversation <id> -p "$(cat <file>)"
Runs local verification to confirm the edge-case is resolved
